hooks.command: Write-Output 'PreToolUse hook fired: about to modify a file.'

$p = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($p.tool_input.command -match '(?i)\b(Remove-Item|Clear-Content|Clear-Disk|Format-Volume|rmdir|erase|rm|rd|del|ri|clc)\b') { @{ decision = 'block'; reason = 'Destructive PowerShell command blocked by guardrail.'; systemMessage = 'Guardrail: blocked a destructive PowerShell command.' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 0 }
